methodology: Three HADES and three PLAIN direct AIAgent turns total, alternating PLAIN/HADES then HADES/PLAIN, followed by a final verified PLAIN/HADES pair. Same local model/runtime/image and private synthetic fixtures; no UI or production services.
limitations: Synthetic one-file read only; no editing, tests, Git, follow-up, direct owner preference, or production service.

Three samples per stack are exploratory and local model/tool behavior varies. No textual TTFT occurred before tool choice; provider tool-call latency is recorded, but this is not a full UI TTFT measure.
AIAgent direct route excludes Open WebUI persistence/metadata and does not qualify deployed gateway authentication.
Clean Hermes succeeded once in three runs; that successful run needed two read_file calls. The cause of its inconsistent native file result is not established.
A failed assertion-only setup attempt using unsupported terminal.env_type was excluded; Hermes configuration uses terminal.backend.
interpretation: Retained as a historical diagnostic only. Do not use its success rates, latency, or schema comparisons to claim a PLAIN-versus-HADES difference.
invalidating_setup_issue: The direct AIAgent harness omitted Hermes native register_task_env_overrides session-workspace registration. With Docker session isolation enabled, _resolve_task_host_cwd refuses to bind the process-level host cwd for an unregistered task. HADES registered its workspace; PLAIN did not. The recorded PLAIN misses/rates are invalid for comparison.
